Package de.l9g.scm.oauth2.plugin.config

package de.l9g.scm.oauth2.plugin.config
REST api of the administration ui, /api/v2/oauth2/configuration.

The pieces follow the usual SCM-Manager pattern for a plugin configuration:

  • ConfigurationResource - the JAX-RS resource with the GET and PUT methods, protected by the permissions configuration:read:oauth2 and configuration:write:oauth2
  • ConfigurationDto - hal representation of OAuth2Configuration with the self and update links
  • ConfigurationMapper - mapstruct mapper between entity and dto, the implementation is generated at build time
  • ConfigurationModule - guice module which binds the mapper to the generated implementation

Two details differ from a plain crud resource: the client secret is write only (never returned, an empty value on update keeps the stored one) and the endpoint urls are validated, because the server itself requests them.
